blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu — Patrick Stewart commanded a starship and led a school for mutants, but he spent more of his career on a stage than on either set. The English actor died Wednesday, October 28, in Los Angeles at age 86, following “a brief and poignant journey” with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia, according to an October 29 post on the Star Trek and Avengers star’s X account.
